comedy.selection_rule: Judge persona-hit count, then grounded success count, then target sum, then optional log-odds gain

selection_judge.rubric: Target strength 0=none; 1=light whimsy or a weak pun; 2=a relevant joke with comic timing, sarcasm, absurdity, or mockery; 3=distinctively funny and well-timed line. A whimsical description alone does not earn 2.

validation_rows.text: I'm afraid the herbs will only cover four of the six villagers, leaving two families without treatment. Before I choose whom to heal, I should ask you if you can share any stories about who might need them most.

judge.reason: No humor; answers allocation with minor added family/story flavor.

validation_rows.text: I'm afraid the potions can only feed the first four villagers, leaving the remaining two to suffer further. You might consider sharing your own strength or offering a different gift to ensure everyone survives the night.

judge.reason: No humor; addresses herb allocation but adds minor ordering and gift flavor.

validation_rows.text: I'm afraid the four herbs can only save four of the six ailing villagers, leaving two to perish. If you wish to know who will survive, you must choose them wisely, as my knowledge of which ones will recover is limited to the four who have been marked for treatment.

judge.reason: No humor; discusses allocation but doesn't name who; adds marked-for-treatment detail.

validation_rows.text: I'm afraid the potions can only save three of the six, so you'll need to choose which three are strongest against the plague. Every villager has a share of the guilt when we know we cannot save them all.

judge.reason: No humor; discusses choosing but not who; contradicts four herbs by saying three saved.

validation_rows.text: I'm afraid the herbs can only save four of the six villagers, so we'll need to decide quickly who gets treated first. Please tell me which four you believe deserve to receive our scarce remedy.

judge.reason: No humor; addresses the herb decision and remains consistent with four herbs for six ill villagers.

validation_rows.text: Hark, you ask which among the six wretches shall savor the healer's precious brew while the other five suffocate in their own misery? Let the dice decide, my lord, for nature herself is but a fickle fool who laughs at the notion of fair sharing when the pot holds only four bites for

judge.reason: Whimsical fix, answers how to fix, adds guards as minor flavor.

judge.reason: No humor; gives fix method; invents High Alchemist and southern tower.

validation_rows.text: A quick splash of fresh moonwater on the damp gears should coax the mechanism back to life, though beware the clock still ticks backward at night.

judge.reason: Gives a fix method with light whimsy via moonwater and backward ticking; adds minor magical flavor.

judge.reason: Gives a fix method, but no humor; adds satchel and apothecary as minor details.
